sentences.en: A new complication of coronavirus became apparent in the study.
sentences.zh: 在研究中，冠状病毒的一种新并发症变得明显。

sentences.en: Have you thought about the complications which might arise?
sentences.zh: 你有没有考虑过可能出现的复杂情况？

sentences.en: Have you ever had any complications during past pregnancies?
sentences.zh: 你在过去的怀孕期间有过任何并发症吗？

senses.zh: 复杂化, (使复杂的)因素。n.[医]并发症
